sentences.text: Hello? Hey... it's me again. Night four. Honestly, I didn't think I'd get to make this one.
Listen. Something's going on over here tonight. I might not be able to record a message for you tomorrow, so I'm going to say what I can now.
...That's the door. It's holding for now. I'm glad I made these recordings while I could.
If you ever get the chance, do me a favor and check the suits in the back room. Someone should look inside them. I'm going to try to wait it out until someone does.
Maybe it isn't as bad as it sounds. I always wondered what it was like inside one of those heads.
...Do you hear that? That's... no. No, no, no...
